//: GOVERNANCE MANIFEST — approved IgnoreQueryFilters() usage in ComplianceService.
IgnoreQueryFilters() disables tenant filtering for the ENTIRE LINQ query, not for the entity
it is called on (proven in Wave 2.2B.3.3: a join to obligations silently unfiltered the
deficiency root, making the CAPA grid show 176 under an 88 header). Treat every entry here as
a query-level exemption from tenant isolation.
QueryIsolationGovernanceTests fails the build when a file's count exceeds its approved value,
or when an unlisted file introduces one. To add a bypass you must edit this file, which forces
A - Tenant scoped        : bypass should be removed
B - Partially global     : replace with explicit Organization filtering
D - Bootstrap            : runs before tenant context exists
'category' below is the CURRENT assessment. Anything still A or B is debt (TD-01), not
approval — the count is frozen so it cannot grow while the cleanup proceeds.

Controllers/Internal/InternalJourneyObli.note: Journey obligation reads; explicit org scope likely possible.

Application/Services/DeficiencyCommandCe.note: Detail/task/evidence lookups keyed by ids from an already-scoped query. Dashboard + workspace roots already hardened (Wave 2.2B.3.3).

Infrastructure/Repositories/ObligationRe.note: Repository-level; candidate for explicit organizationId parameter.

Application/Services/StageUnlockingServi.note: Stage unlock evaluation can run during onboarding before journey context settles.

Application/Services/UpdateObligationJou.note: As above — carries an explicit OrganizationId predicate.
